```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof t = scrubber(periods)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
p = ({s, alpha, delta, n, g})
pShock = ({...p, s: sShock})
hasShock = sShock !== s
path = simulate(k0, p, periods, {shock: {t: shockT, params: {s: sShock}}})

// Steady states before and after the shock.
kStarBefore = steadyState(p)
kStarAfter = steadyState(pShock)
kMax = 1.5 * Math.max(kStarBefore, kStarAfter, k0)
grid = d3.range(0, kMax * 1.0001, kMax / 200).map(k => ({
  k,
  investmentBefore: s * output(k, p),
  investmentAfter: sShock * output(k, p),
  breakEven: breakEven(k, p)
}))

// State of the economy at the current point in the animation.
now = path[t]
shocked = t >= shockT
kStar = shocked ? kStarAfter : kStarBefore
investmentNow = now.s * output(now.k, p)
breakEvenNow = breakEven(now.k, p)

colours = ({investment: "#4269d0", breakEven: "#ff725c", gap: "#3ca951"})
```

$k_t =$ ${now.k.toFixed(2)},
investment $=$ ${investmentNow.toFixed(3)},
break-even investment $=$ ${breakEvenNow.toFixed(3)}.
Steady state: $k^* =$ ${kStar.toFixed(2)}.
